# Velan Joint Ventures

> Joint venture advisory and strategic partnership support for businesses, based in West Mambalam, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India.

Velan Joint Ventures helps businesses explore partnerships, assess opportunities and structure joint ventures. The pages below describe its services. General information only; not legal, tax or financial advice.

## Contact
- Website: https://www.velanjointventures.in/
- Address: 25/1, Old No. 14, Nakkeeran St, West Mambalam, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600033, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 96264 12116
- Enquiries: https://www.velanjointventures.in/contact
